sections.heading: Opening Cachly from Other Apps (URL Scheme)
sections.text: Cachly registers the cachly:// URL scheme, so any app that can open a link — Shortcuts, Notes, Reminders, a spreadsheet, an NFC-tag automation, a launcher app or another geocaching tool — can launch Cachly or jump straight to a specific cache. URL What it does cachly:// Opens Cachly (or brings it to the front) exactly where you left it. Nothing else happens. cachly://gccode=GC18 Opens the cache page for that GC code as a card over whatever is on screen. Replace GC18 with any GC code; case doesn’t matter. When you open a cache this way, Cachly first looks for it in your offline lists . If it finds a saved copy, that copy opens instantly and works without a connection. Otherwise Cachly fetches the cache live from geocaching.com, so you need to be online and the GC code has to exist. Swipe the card down or tap Done to return to where you were. ⓘ You must be signed in to geocaching.com for the gccode link to work; before sign-in, any cachly:// link simply opens the app. Only GC codes are accepted — Adventure Lab and other non-GC identifiers are ignored. Any other parameters in the URL are ignored too. Example: a Shortcut that opens a cache In the Shortcuts app, create a new shortcut and add the Open URLs action. Enter cachly://gccode= followed by the GC code (or an Ask Each Time variable so the shortcut prompts you for the code). Run it from the Shortcuts widget, Siri, the Action button, or an NFC tag automation. A tag on your geocaching bag could open the cache you’re currently working on. 💡 You don’t need the URL scheme for ordinary geocaching.com or coord.info links: copy one and Cachly offers to open the cache the next time it comes to the front (see Detect Geocache Links ), or paste it into the Live tab search field . The cachly:// scheme is for automation, where there is no web link to copy.

Inside the More Tab

iPad

On iPad, Cachly runs full-screen with the same interface as on iPhone, giving the map, lists and cache details more room, and it works alongside other apps with iPadOS multitasking. See iPad.

Opening Cachly from Other Apps (URL Scheme)

Cachly registers the cachly:// URL scheme, so any app that can open a link — Shortcuts, Notes, Reminders, a spreadsheet, an NFC-tag automation, a launcher app or another geocaching tool — can launch Cachly or jump straight to a specific cache.

URLWhat it does
cachly://Opens Cachly (or brings it to the front) exactly where you left it. Nothing else happens.
cachly://gccode=GC18Opens the cache page for that GC code as a card over whatever is on screen. Replace GC18 with any GC code; case doesn’t matter.

When you open a cache this way, Cachly first looks for it in your offline lists. If it finds a saved copy, that copy opens instantly and works without a connection. Otherwise Cachly fetches the cache live from geocaching.com, so you need to be online and the GC code has to exist. Swipe the card down or tap Done to return to where you were.

ⓘ
You must be signed in to geocaching.com for the gccode link to work; before sign-in, any cachly:// link simply opens the app. Only GC codes are accepted — Adventure Lab and other non-GC identifiers are ignored. Any other parameters in the URL are ignored too.

Example: a Shortcut that opens a cache

  1. In the Shortcuts app, create a new shortcut and add the Open URLs action.
  2. Enter cachly://gccode= followed by the GC code (or an Ask Each Time variable so the shortcut prompts you for the code).
  3. Run it from the Shortcuts widget, Siri, the Action button, or an NFC tag automation. A tag on your geocaching bag could open the cache you’re currently working on.
💡
You don’t need the URL scheme for ordinary geocaching.com or coord.info links: copy one and Cachly offers to open the cache the next time it comes to the front (see Detect Geocache Links), or paste it into the Live tab search field. The cachly:// scheme is for automation, where there is no web link to copy.
